title: Senator Amidala’s Starship
front_description: Returning to the Galactic for an all-important vote, Senator Padmé Amidala and her entourage descend to the planet Coruscant in a Naboo Royal Cruiser. upon setting down on the landing platform, Amidala's vehicle is blown to pieces. But the resourceful Senator survives this assassination attempt. She grieves for her loyal aide Cordé, an Amidala double who was killed in the blast.
back_description: Doug Chang's rendering of Senator Amidala's  ill-fated royal cruiser.
